name: Street Space Quality for Older Adults' Leisure Activity in Guangzhou
description:
Method replication: same task, scale and design as the paper; the images are not the paper's stimuli (123 Baidu street views re-fetched in the Yuexiu, Liwan and Haizhu districts of Guangzhou, one direction per panorama). Each participant rates 50 street views on a 5-point scale (very poor, poor, fair, good, very good) answering the paper's question: from the point of view of physical leisure activity, such as whether it is suitable for you to take a walk, how would you rate its quality?

Original study: Du & Huang (2022), ISPRS Int. J. Geo-Inf. 11(4), 241. 90 residents aged 60+ (10 per street, convenience sampling, face-to-face) rated 900 Baidu street images from 9 streets in the three central districts of Guangzhou on the same 5-point scale; the scores were regressed on segmented street elements (green view and sidewalk positive) and predicted city-wide with a random forest.

Differences from the original study: (1) images are newly fetched Baidu views, not the 900 original images; (2) each participant rates 50 random images instead of the 100 images of their own street; (3) online self-completion instead of interviewer-led scoring with follow-up interviews; (4) an age question and three short questions (gender, district, outdoor activity frequency) were added.
author: Du & Huang
